# drawn 2D coords (image px) -> chemistry coords (x right, y up)

 'H8':(702,463),'Me23':(552,80),'O24':(630,105),'H14':(737,208)}

 'O3','Me18','Me19','H5','Me20','H8','Me23','O24','H14']
P2=np.array([[draw[k][0]/50., (769-draw[k][1])/50.] for k in order])
idx={k:i for i,k in enumerate(order)}

stereo=[('O3','C3','up'),('Me18','C4','down'),('Me19','C4','up'),('H5','C5','down'),
        ('Me20','C10','up'),('H8','C8','up'),('Me23','C13','up'),('O24','C13','down'),

    X=m.GetConformer().GetPositions()[:len(order)]
    X=X-X.mean(0)
    Pc=P2-P2.mean(0)
    def loss(p):
        rot=R.from_rotvec(p[:3]); s=p[3]
        Y=rot.apply(X)*s
        return ((Y[:,:2]-Pc)**2).sum()
    best=None
    for seed in range(200):
        rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
        p0=np.concatenate([rng.normal(size=3)*2,[1.0]])

    rmsd=np.sqrt(best.fun/len(order))
    ok=0; det=[]

        ok+=good
        det.append('%s@%s %s dz=%+.2f %s'%(sub,at,w,dz,'OK' if good else 'X'))
    print(f,'rmsd=%.3f'%rmsd,'match %d/10'%ok)
    for d in det: print('    ',d)
